description: This file defines the 'MobileModelRunner' class, which provides functionality for loading, inspecting, and executing mobile-optimized PyTorch models. It includes methods for loading models from file paths or streams, retrieving operator information, managing bundled inputs, and running the model with specified inputs.

classes.name: MobileModelRunner
classes.description: A class for loading, querying, and running mobile-optimized TorchScript models.

methods.name: MobileModelRunner(std::string const & file_path,uint64_t module_load_options)
methods.description: Constructs a MobileModelRunner by loading a model from a file path or stream.

methods.name: set_has_metal_gpu_operators
methods.description: Checks if the given operator list contains any Metal GPU operators.

methods.name: get_operators_from_mobile_info_json
methods.description: Extracts operator names from the 'extra/mobile_info.json' file within a model archive.

methods.name: ivalue_to_bundled_inputs
methods.description: Converts an 'at::IValue' to a vector of 'at::IValue' bundles.

methods.name: ivalue_to_bundled_inputs_map
methods.description: Converts an 'at::IValue' to a map of bundled inputs per function.

methods.name: get_all_bundled_inputs
methods.description: Retrieves all bundled inputs for the loaded model.

methods.name: get_many_functions_bundled_inputs
methods.description: Retrieves bundled inputs for all functions of the model.

methods.name: bool has_new_style_bundled_inputs() const
methods.description: Checks if the model supports 'get_bundled_inputs_functions_and_info' method.

methods.name: for_each_tensor_in_bundled_inputs
methods.description: Applies a user-provided function to each tensor in the bundled inputs.

methods.name: std::set<std::string> get_root_operators()
methods.description: Returns the set of root operators directly called by the model.

methods.name: run_with_inputs
methods.description: Runs the model with specified bundled inputs and returns the outputs.

methods.name: run_with_inputs
methods.description: Runs the specified function of the model with bundled inputs.

methods.name: run_argless_functions
methods.description: Attempts to run a list of zero-argument functions within the model.
